sources.title: Verify OpenAI-generated content
sources.snippet: The content could still have been generated by OpenAI if its metadata was stripped or tampered with, its watermark was degraded, it came from a legacy generation model, or it was created before provenance signals were available. Content could also still be AI-generated by another company's model, which the tool currently does not detect.
